title: C21 Toulec
prompt: Low-angle close-up of an old worn leather quiver lying on its side on dark stones, its opening glows like a bottomless rift of swirling bright orange chaos magic, and an endless stream of dozens of arrows pours out of the rift and flies upward, crackling orange lightning arcs and orange sparks around the arrows. No people, no hands. Background: blurred hot red-orange glow and drifting embers. Palette: deep red, burnt orange, bright yellow-orange highlights, black shadows, no teal. No text.

title: C23 Experiment
prompt: Medium shot of a cluttered alchemist's table at night, a large round glass flask in the centre has cracked open, and from it bursts a shapeless glowing orange chaos creature made of molten liquid that is splitting into three smaller wobbly copies of itself, orange chaos smoke, spilled potions, broken glass, crackling orange sparks. No people, no hands. Background: cold dark teal laboratory with shelves, strong contrast of glowing orange chaos against cold dark teal. No text.

title: C28 Trofej
prompt: Macro close-up of a battered iron war helmet with curved horns mounted as a trophy on a wooden pole, captured enemy swords and spears are being pulled toward it by glowing chains of bright orange chaos energy, crackling orange lightning, orange sparks and glowing cracks across the helmet. title: C45 Sipka

title: 116 Replikace
